name: Ray Model Voxelization
definition: A voxelization pipeline that converts sparse LiDAR point clouds into dense 3D occupancy grids by tracing rays from sensor origins to detected points, classifying voxels as free, occupied, or unobserved.
summary: Ray Model Voxelization converts LiDAR points into 3D grids by tracing rays to classify voxels as free, occupied, or unobserved, explicitly modeling empty space unlike hard voxelization.
